chapters.name: Whiteout
chapters.brief: A botched ferry robbery leaves the gang freezing in the Whitecap mountains.

chapters.name: Oxbow
chapters.brief: Green valleys, fat towns, and the slow rot of easy money.

chapters.name: The Feud
chapters.brief: Two families bleeding each other dry — and Silas means to profit from both.

chapters.name: Giltmarch
chapters.brief: The big shining city eats outlaws alive.

chapters.name: The Isle
chapters.brief: Shipwrecked in a tyrant's cane paradise.

chapters.name: The Unraveling
chapters.brief: The Bureau closes in and the gang tears itself apart.

chapters.name: The Ranch Hand
chapters.brief: Eli Ward tries an honest life. It almost takes.

chapters.name: Ward's Hope
chapters.brief: A house, a debt, and one last reckoning.

missions.b: The Ironhaven ferry job explodes into gunfire. Ride through the blizzard to Frosthold or die in the snow.

missions.t: Ride In, Haunted by a Name
missions.b: Eli Ward is lost in the storm. Ride the ridge line, find him, and drag him home.
Kett Moran's lookouts watch the pass. Burn them out before they sell the camp's position.
A widow's farmhouse holds the dead — and food the camp needs to live through the week.

missions.t: Who in Hell Is Harlan Suttler?
missions.b: Suttler's private train crosses the pass. Rob its strongbox and learn the rail baron's name.
missions.src: Who the Hell Is Leviticus Cornwall

missions.b: The thaw opens the pass. Escort the wagons down out of the mountains to Oxbow Bluff.
Finn Malloy got himself grabbed by bounty hunters. Spring him out of Emberton — loudly, if needed.
A rare quiet night at Oxbow Bluff. Sing, deal, drink — tomorrow the ledger calls.
o: Lead the song or deal the cards?

missions.t: Exit, Chased by a Wounded Pride
missions.b: A legendary grey bear stalks the Cumberland woods. Hunt it with Father Ansel — and mind its charge.
missions.src: Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego

missions.b: The captive Clem Prior knows where Moran's crew holes up. Persuade him to share.
One drink in Emberton with Eli. It is never one drink.
Reverend Halloran drank himself into a chapel brawl. Drag him out before the law does.
The ledger feeds the camp. Ride the debt row: a farm, a mill, and men who'd rather run.
A poacher camp owes Pell money and answers. Collect both.
Cole Rattler sits in a Cloverdale cell, talking too much. Break him out before he talks to the wrong ears.
A prison stagecoach carries a friend to the rope. Hit it on the canyon road.
A Suttler oil train runs weekly through the valley. Scout its guards, its schedule, its weak car.
Take young Jonah fishing on the Dakota. The fish bite; the boy talks; the war waits.
Stop the oil train, crack the payroll car, and vanish before Ironhaven hears of it.
A letter from Nora Ellison, the woman Cade left behind. Her kin need a gun. Old debts ache.
Suttler's ranch fattens cattle on stolen range. Rustle a herd back under cover of dark.
A fat homestead, an empty strongbox in camp. Ansel plans a clean, quiet robbery.
Moran raiders burn homesteads for sport. June asks Cade to stand a line with her.
A traveling tonic peddler owes the ledger — and road agents mean to rob him first. Beat them to it.
Two families — Ashford and Colbrand — bleed the county dry. Silas means to rob them both. Start by smiling at both.
The gang needs a front. Plaster Marshfield with handbills for Bodie's miracle tonic empire.
Lennie swears the chain gang holds two of ours. Spring them — then discover who they really are.
Halloran holds a service for men who've killed. Then the men he killed for come calling.

missions.t: A Short Stroll in a Fair Town
missions.b: Walk the Marshfield bank with Silas. Count the guards, the windows, the minutes.
missions.src: A Short Walk in a Pretty Town

missions.b: The Ashford leaf barns fund their private army. Burn them to the foundation stones.
Thaddeus Belcour got himself arrested mid-scam. Cut him out of the Marshfield jail.
Colbrand racers are worth a fortune at the Grayhook fence. Steal the whole stable by moonlight.
Belcour's stage show packs the theater. While eyes are on him, empty the theater safe.
The burned town of Gomorrah still hides a gun cache. Looters got there first.
Kett Moran raids the camp at midnight with fire and rifles. Hold the line or lose everything.
Both families betrayed the gang. Hit Ashford Hall and Colbrand Hall in one night.
Poppy Ashford loves a Colbrand boy. Smuggle Rhett to the gazebo for one stolen hour.
The families found out. Ride the lovers to the station through kin who'd kill them.
Silas brokers a 'peace' between the families. It is a trap — the only question is whose.
June speaks for women's votes on the Marshfield square. Escort her through a hostile crowd.
Raider stills in the swamp fund Moran's guns. Blow every still sky-high.
Giltmarch City: gaslight, trolley bells, and ten thousand witnesses. Settle into Murkwell Hall.

missions.t: Don Vecchio, a Man of Honor
missions.b: The don of Giltmarch holds young Jonah as 'guest'. Pay court, smile, and bring the boy home.
missions.src: Angelo Bronte, a Man of Honor

missions.b: A masquerade ball at the manor. Dance, listen, and lift the don's black book.
Bureau Agent Hale offers Cade a deal on the bridge: the gang for a pardon. Answer him.
o: Take the deal or spit on it?

missions.b: Old Bodie knows every saloon in Giltmarch. A night of cards and whiskey — and one brawl.
Bureau riders chase Hunter through a levee storm. Ride out and turn the chase around.
A trolley payroll crosses town at dusk. Belcour plans the stops; Cade provides the guns.
The bayou pays for gator hides. Hunt with Hunter where the water moves wrong.
Vecchio sold the gang to the Bureau. June leads the raid on his manor — no quarter.
missions.src: Revenge Is a Dish Best Eaten

missions.b: The Giltmarch National Bank. Silas's masterpiece: in, rich, and gone before the trolley stops.
The Bureau grabbed Eli at the docks. Cut him out of the Giltmarch jail tonight.
The camp frays. Widow Karn sends Cade to mend it: Ada, Jonah, and empty stew pots.
missions.src: Brothers and Sisters, One and All

missions.b: Riots burn the tenement blocks. Escort Jonah home through fire and militia.
The Bureau raids Murkwell Hall at dawn. Hold them, then run for the docks and a waiting ship.
The ship breaks on the Crowsnest reef. Crawl up the beach and count who is left.
Governor Cazal 'employs' the survivors in his cane fields. Smile, cut cane, plan.
Ajax Ona's rebels free the field workers at dawn. Bring a gun and mean it.
Burn Cazal's cane, then storm his fort before the garrison wakes.
A stolen gunboat waits at the docks. Hold the pier until the tide turns.
Those left behind deserve word. Write the letter Eli dictates — every hard true line.
Back on Harrow soil, the gang reunites for one night. Drink it in; dawn comes fast.
Silas's plan smells like a grave. Eli offers another road. Choose — out loud, in front of all.
o: Follow Silas or ride with Eli?

missions.b: Clem Prior was taken to the Moran caves. Go into the dark after him.
Belcour's balloon drifts over the Bureau camp. Sketch the guns from the clouds.
Eli sits in an Ironhaven cell. Bribe the turnkey and hear what the Bureau asked him.
The Moran hideout at last. No plan, no parley — just morning and rifles.
Bureau agents hit Otterden at first light. Wake shooting.
Grayhook: cards, debts, and Bodie's 'prospects'. Work the tables, squeeze the debtors.
Father Ansel is dying and knows it. Walk him up the hill for the last confession.
Colonel Marrow's soldiers burn the Gray Wolf reserve. Stand with the tribe.
The Ironhaven bridge carries Bureau reinforcements. Drop it into the gorge.
An army payroll lies cached at a dig site. Dig fast, shoot faster.
One last job: Silas lays out the final train robbery. Hear every voice at the fire.
Agent Hale wants a parley. It is a trap with coffee. Spring it on him instead.
June's ghosts ride tonight. Join her raid on the ranch that killed her husband.
Young Hawk rots in a stockade. Break the tribe's son out of Marrow's fort.
Silas demands the gang choose: his madness or the door. Answer to his face.
A last supper at Otterden. Ada, Jonah, Eli — say what needs saying.
The final train: Suttler's gold shipment. Everything the gang ever wanted rides those rails.
Wounded, hunted, the gold gone. Reach the woods cabin before the Bureau dogs do.
The last ride up the ridge. Cade's final choice: the gold, or Eli's life.
o: Help Eli escape or chase the gold?

missions.b: Years of feud end at a train platform. See the lovers off to a freer state.
Longhorn Ranch needs horses broken. Eli Ward needs honest pay. Hold on tight.
Drive the ranch wagon to Cloverdale with Jonah. Simple work, good talk.
Hay, fences, and blistered hands. The honest life, one chore at a time.
Teach Jonah to hunt rabbits. Patience first, trigger second.
Rustlers hit the Longhorn herd. The ranch hands are scared — Eli is not.
Track the rustlers to their canyon camp and take the herd back with interest.
Wolves corner Jonah in the barn. Run.
Ada takes the train bag packed. Talk her down at the station — or let her go.
The rustlers come for the ranch house itself. Hold the porch till sunrise.
A bank loan buys the Ward's Hope plot. Sign the papers in Cloverdale.
The build crew settles wages with fists. Bodie bets on Eli. Win.
Raise the barn before the rains. Haul lumber till your shoulders burn.
Hay and water, dawn to dusk. The ranch grows one honest day at a time.
Fetch Bodie's tools from town. Two thugs remember Eli from the old days.
Finish the farmhouse. Hang the door Ada picked out herself.
Hunter Grey rides in lean and hungry: wolves took his camp. Return the old favor.
missions.src: A Quick Favor for an Old Friend

missions.b: Bounty hunters caught Bodie in the gully. Cut the old fool loose.
A chapel, a ring, a second chance. Marry Ada properly this time.
Old Ivory, the ghost bison of the peaks. One last legendary hunt.
Peace at last — until a Bureau letter arrives and June rides in with news.
Cole Rattler and Agent Quill wait at the mine. End it — all of it — with gunfire.
